title: Furnished Quarters
description: About Furnished Quarters Headquartered in New York City, New York, Furnished Quarters, is to deliver exceptional residential experiences with passion, reliability and integrity always innovating and putting people first. They consider this in everything they do and every guest and client experience they deliver. The company "Furnished Quarters" was the victim of a successful cyberattack, as a result of which the company’s confidential data was stolen. The volume of data stolen amounts to 155 GB. The data stolen included the company’s customer details, as well as documents containing banking and financial information. Currently, around 198,000 files are no longer under the control of "Furnished Quarters".
